property_summary: For all inputs where the owner calls Command forwarding some ether to a callee that deliberately reverts, the reference contract C never reverts the call (it swallows the failing low-level call) while the mutant that requires the low-level call's success will revert; thus the invariant is that a Command call from Owner to a reverting callee always returns (does not revert) in the reference but may revert in the mutant.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a checked call that reverts on failure by requiring the call returns true, changing observable behavior when the call fails.
